title: ConfigChanged
description: The payload of a `config.changed` audit entry on the org's chain (stream `cp:{orgId}`, 02-lld §2.10, §7): one per committed control-plane write. Ids, revisions, digests and field paths only; never a value of a binding, a credential or a run's content.

object.description: What changed: a kind of control-plane object and its id (`policy-section`/`approvals`, `model-account`/`org/{accountId}`, `schedule`/`{id}`, `platform-settings`/`labs`, `mcp-manifest`/`{instanceId}`).

revisionFrom.description: The object's own revision before the write; null where the object has none yet (KV documents until CPD-4).

changeDigest.description: Canonical digest of the object's new non-secret value.

beforeDigest.description: Canonical digest of the object's non-secret value before the write; null when it did not exist. Absent on entries written before CPD-11.

changed.description: Dotted paths of the fields that changed, sorted; empty for a save that kept the stored value.

narrowing.description: True only when the change can only remove authority (drives the live layer, CPD-6).

approvalRef.description: The approval request the write applied, if any.

headRevision.description: The org head revision the write committed as; the audit entry's `journalSeq`.

repaired.description: Recorded by the ordered-steps repair for a writer that stopped after its effects (standalone Mongo).
